### The Lost Word (2 Chronicles 34:15) - Your Daily Bible Verse - July 6
Author: Brent Rinehart
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-july-6.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 34:15
Points:
- Neglecting God's Word rarely happens all at once, but rather through a slow, gradual drift.
- Judah lost touch with the Lord because generations set aside and forgot His commands.
- Believers must identify and remove the clutter in life that crowds out Scripture.
- Daily engagement with the Bible is necessary for spiritual health, direction, and renewal.

### Josiah and the Re-Discovery of God’s Law
Author: Andy Rau
Site: Bible Gateway Blog
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/blog/2011/07/josiah-and-the-re-discovery-of-gods-law/
Passage: 2 Chronicles 34:14-21
Points:
- God preserved His written Word through generations of widespread spiritual decay.
- King Josiah demonstrated genuine humility and sorrow upon hearing the neglected Law read aloud.
- Scripture serves as an illuminating lamp that reveals disobedience and points people to repentance.
- Believers and leaders must examine whether their worship and service follow God's standards.
